title: docs: simplify review and code-simplifier guidance
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Makes the existing review command and simplifier use the shared coding principles in AGENTS.md, following #14581.
- Removes duplicated style rules, the generic findings template, and automatic simplification instructions; preserves scope and behavior checks.
- Keeps advisory reviews read-only unless fixes are requested and asks for concrete findings with relevant verification gaps.
- Documentation only: two files, 57 fewer lines. Validated agent frontmatter, guidance references, and whitespace; Biome does not process Markdown.

gist.headline: Less Script, Same Scrutiny
gist.blurb: The review bees put away the duplicate rulebook. Shared AGENTS.md principles now guide both review and simplification, while the useful guardrails stay planted.
gist.summary: Simplified the code-simplifier and review agent guidance to reuse AGENTS.md principles, retain scope and behavior checks, keep advisory reviews read-only, and require concrete findings with verification gaps.
gist.impact: Contributors get leaner, consistent review guidance while advisory reviews remain non-destructive unless fixes are explicitly requested.
